title: review-frontend-code input
description: Input contract for the review-frontend-code Review stage. Consumes the design plus the entire output of an upstream implement-frontend-feature stage plus the file contents the workflow fetched. Validated by the workflow engine before invocation.

design_document.description: The same approved UI design the upstream Generate stage consumed. Used at step 2 to extract the truth against which claims are checked.

target_feature_path.description: Same path the Generate stage targeted.

implement_stage_output.description: Verbatim output payload of implement-frontend-feature for this feature. Structure validated separately against that skill's schemas/output.json.

code_under_review.description: Production files emitted by Generate, with the declared pillar. Reviewer needs the pillar to apply Primitive / Feature / Page rules.

idempotency_key.description: UUID v4 carried from the workflow. Same input MUST produce the same verdict bytes.

convention_overrides.description: Optional. Same shape as the implement stage's overrides — passed to the reviewer so a divergence from defaults is not mis-flagged.

severity_floor.description: Findings below this severity are dropped from output. Default P3 (emit everything). Note: P1 in a11y / token storage / PII still routes human-queue regardless of floor.
